management.draft_help: Save the configuration for review. It starts disabled and is ready for activation once the corresponding service is integrated.
management.title: Administration
management.trunks_help: Review saved trunks. Provider activation and registration require FreeSWITCH and verified SIP credentials.
management.extensions_help: Review extension numbers. Provisioning a phone requires a configured FreeSWITCH profile.
management.inbound_help: Review inbound rules. Each number needs a destination such as an extension, queue or voice menu.
management.outbound_help: Review outbound rules and digit patterns. Verify the carrier and allowed destinations before enabling calls.
management.ivr_help: Review voice menus. Prepare a greeting and assign a destination for each digit.
management.queues_help: Review queues and their distribution strategies. Prepare agent extensions before routing callers into a queue.
management.sms_help: Review existing conversations. Sending requires a verified messaging provider and an eligible number.
management.contacts_help: Add a customer by name and include an email address or phone number when available.
management.billing_help: Review rate tables and currencies. Verify carrier rates before using them for billing.
management.voice_help: Review recorded voice AI sessions. Activating a provider requires credentials and explicit approval of usage charges.
management.security_help: Review recorded sign-in and sign-out activity.
management.maintenance_help: Check the services this application is configured to use.

setup.title: Setup wizard
setup.welcome_help: Connect your services and create your first administrator. Enter the setup key supplied during server provisioning.
setup.readiness_help: Check that this server can run the application securely.
setup.database_help: Use an existing, dedicated PostgreSQL database and a user that can create tables.
setup.redis_help: Redis stores sessions, cache and queued jobs. Enter the connection you want this installation to use.
setup.freeswitch_help: Test the server’s configured FreeSWITCH Event Socket. A server administrator must provision FreeSWITCH before telephony can run.
setup.admin_help: Use a password with 12 or more characters. This account has full access to the control panel.
setup.review_help: Setup will create the database tables and administrator, then save the connection settings.
setup.success_help: PostgreSQL, Redis and the administrator are ready. Sign in to open the control panel.
setup.token_missing: Ask your server administrator to enable installation and provide the setup key.
setup.name: Name
setup.fix_php: Install PHP 8.3 or later with PostgreSQL and sockets extensions.
setup.fix_storage: Give the web service write access to application storage.
setup.fix_assets: Ask your server administrator to build the frontend assets.
setup.fix_https: Open the setup page using HTTPS.
setup.installing: Applying migrations, saving settings and creating the administrator…
setup.error_token: The setup key was rejected. Go back and verify the key with your server administrator.
setup.error_request: The request failed. Check the fields or retry.
setup.error_password: The passwords must match and use no more than 72 bytes.
setup.error_database: PostgreSQL connection failed. Check the server, database name and credentials, then retry.
setup.error_redis: Redis could not read and write the test value. Check the connection and permitted databases, then retry.
setup.error_freeswitch: The FreeSWITCH Event Socket did not return a valid status. Ask your server administrator to check it or continue without telephony.
setup.error_requirements: A readiness check failed. Go back to System readiness and retry.
setup.error_busy: An installation is running. Wait briefly, then retry.
setup.error_installation: Setup could not finish. Check that the database is dedicated to this installation and that application storage is writable, then retry.

install.password_hint: Minimum 12 characters including numbers and symbols
install.domain_hint: e.g. pbx.example.com or server IP address
install.dids_later_hint: DID numbers can be configured later from the dashboard
install.extensions_later_hint: Extensions can be added later from the PBX section
install.optional_later_hint: Optional services (AI, Email, Billing) can be configured after installation
install.complete_desc: Your system is set up. Go to the dashboard to start managing your communications.
install.step_server_desc: Configure server domain and HTTPS options
install.step_numbers_desc: Configure DID numbers and inbound routing
install.step_optional_desc: Enable SMS, Email, Billing and AI
install.step_verify_desc: Check status of all system components
